bff.errorBody.description:
errorBody is every error as a JSON client gets it: a stable code to
switch on, what to tell the customer, and the screen to show with it
when there is one (the login screen with its notice).

error.description: bad_request, unauthenticated, bad_credentials, rate_limited, not_found or internal

bff.loginResponse.description:
loginResponse is what a JSON client gets for a login: the session token
to send back as a bearer, when the session ends whatever happens (it
also ends after fifteen idle minutes), and the home screen, so the
client has nothing more to fetch.

bff.screenBody.description: screenBody is a screen on its own, as the logout answers a JSON client.

core.EventRecord.description:
EventRecord is one event on the bank's record (ADR-0011): something
that happened at an instant, raised by someone, whose cascade is
pending or done.

By.description: who raised it: a user, a customer, a market's name, "clock"

core.Leg.description:
Leg is one side of a movement: the account and the balance it was left
with, signed as the ledger holds it.

Type.description: the path's first segment: Asset, Liability, Equity, Income, Expense

core.Movement.description:
Movement is one ledger movement as written (ADR-0008): a signed amount
from one account to another, the to account's balance rising by it and
the from account's falling, with the balance each is left with, in the
bank's view.

Cause.description:
Cause is the root event a rule's posting was made under (ADR-0011)
and Step the posting's name within it; nil and empty for a movement
that is not a rule's, or from before the record.

screen.Action.description:
Action is what happens when the user taps a component. Exactly one of the
fields is set.

screen.description: GET this path and show the result

submit.description: POST form values to this path

screen.Component.description:
Component is one element of a screen body. Type selects the component and
which of the other fields are meaningful; unused fields are omitted from
JSON.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money a row or tx shows; the renderer picks the glyph by it

screen.Field.description: Field is one input in a form.

screen.Icon.description: Icon names a glyph. Clients map icons to their icon set.

screen.Nav.description: Nav is the bottom tab bar.

screen.Pair.description: Pair is a label/value line inside a hero or details component.

path.description: GET path that returns this screen

screen.Tab.description: Tab is one entry in the bottom tab bar.

screen.Tone.description: Tone selects a colour treatment. Clients map tones to their theme.

staff.AboutOwed.description: AboutOwed is core.Owed as another program reads it.

events.description: root events due and not done: cascades in progress (ADR-0011)

staff.AboutPosition.description: AboutPosition is the bank's position: what the dashboard leads with.

savings.description: formatted, as the dashboard shows it

staff.AboutRestart.description:
AboutRestart is one row of the restart record, newest first, read with
the row before it (see Restart).

intact.description: day and customers equal across the stop; null when the previous row cannot say

staff.AboutSim.description:
AboutSim is the run as it is now, with the two rates a performance run
reads: customers added per second (the live rate while a batch add runs,
else the last batch's) and account days per 12h at the pass's measured
whole-day rate, with the last day it is made of.

clock.description: the bank's clock now (simulated time), RFC 3339 UTC

day_ends_in.description: Go duration; "0s" when flat out or stopped

day_refused.description: why the bank would not follow the clock when last asked

last_day_duration.description: Go duration; "" before the first day

next_event.description: the event the run loop waits for: "payment at 2020-03-04T10:32:00Z"

owed.description: what the bank owed when last asked (ADR-0010); a drill waits for at_rest

wall.description: the wall clock now, RFC 3339 UTC

warp.description: simulated seconds per wall second; 0 when flat out

staff.AboutStatus.description:
AboutStatus is the demo's state as another program reads it, at
/about.json: the version and schema this process runs, the console
settings, the run's position and the restart record. gobank-deploy's
upgrade drill reads it before and after each redeploy to compare the
position and read the downtime off the newest restart row.

staff.SchemaVersion.description: SchemaVersion is the version a component's tables are at.

tags.description:
Package bff is the backend-for-frontend for the Model Bank apps.

It is the only server the thin clients talk to. It owns sessions and login,
and turns banking data into screen-ready trees (package screen). Apart from
health, the public login screen and login itself, every endpoint requires a
session; the customer identity always comes from the session, never from
the request.

The banking core is reached through the core package's CustomerQueries and
Authenticator contracts (ADR-0002).
tags.name: bff

tags.description:
Package staff is the staff web of the Model Bank: the login (story
1.7.1), the pages a member of staff reads the bank through (accounting,
products, customers, payments, treasury, reports, about and the
documentation), the role the signed-in user holds and the PII
authorisation that gate what they see, the layout every page is
rendered in, and the simulation console when there is one (ADR-0002
stage 6, stories 1.6.3 and 1.6.4).

It reads the bank through core.StaffQueries, acts on it through
core.Commands, checks logins through core.Users and drives the
simulation through Console, and knows nothing else of it. The BFF mounts
it beside the customer routes (bff.Config.Staff) and its sessions are
kept in the BFF's store.
tags.name: staff
